company_name: Shandong Prime-Rel Electronic Technology Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in semiconductor power device testing equipment and has a strong focus on reliability and performance testing.
summary: Shandong Prime-Rel Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise that develops and manufactures testing equipment for semiconductor power devices. Their product offerings include systems for reliability testing, dynamic and static parameter testing, and power cycling, serving a diverse range of clients in the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: Reliability testing systems (HTXB, HAST, H TXB)
Dynamic and static parameter testing equipment
Double pulse testing systems for IGBT, DIODE, and MOSFET
technical_expertise: Power cycling and aging test systems

regional_presence.China: The company has a significant presence in China, having served over 100 well-known units in the semiconductor industry.
